title: Old Is the New New • Kevlin Henney • GOTO 2018
summary: Kevlin Henney's GOTO 2018 talk argues that much of what looks new in software is a recycling of concepts with long histories. It draws on history to show the slow, steady current beneath constant churn in frameworks and trends.
why: HN recommends it for historical perspective on software ideas and for dispelling myths such as the origins of waterfall.

quote.text: There's a talk well worth watching by Kevlin Henney called 'Old Is the New New' [1]
